entities.summary: Christopher Logue, CBE was an English poet associated with the British Poetry Revival, and a pacifist. Christopher Logue was a poets & playwrights from Portsmouth (1926-11-23, Portsmouth–2011-12-02). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Its legacy: Contributed poetry and drama to cultural canon.
